# Your Research Toolkit {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Hermes first — portable alternatives second

## Primary: Hermes {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-hermes" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Best for:** Your everyday workflow — upload your files and have the agent answer
**only from them**, with citations.
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**Superpower:** It's the same agent you'll build on Day 2 — your sources, your rules, in
one place. **Drop in the document → "Based only on this, summarize and cite."**
:::

## Alternative A: NotebookLM (Google) {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-a" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Best for:** Deep reading of massive documents (50+ pages)

**Superpower:** Creates a "Source Guide" solely from *your* documents — no internet hallucinations.
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**Scenario:** Upload 5 competitor sustainability reports → *"Compare Scope 3 emission
targets across all 5 vs. our draft policy. Create a gap table."* Bonus: an Audio Overview
for the drive home.
:::

## Alternative B: Deep Research {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-b" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
**Best for:** Real-time synthesis of the live web

**Superpower:** Reads 20–30 websites in seconds and **footnotes every sentence**.
:::

::: {style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666;"}
Perplexity / ChatGPT / Google Gemini
:::

## Choosing the Right Tool

| Need | Tool | Why |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Your day-to-day, your files | **Hermes** | One agent, your sources + rules, cites |
| Analyze a 100-page PDF | **NotebookLM** | Grounded in your docs only |
| Live market intelligence | **Deep Research** | Real-time web with citations |

# Activity {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

The 10-Hour Research Task in 10 Minutes

## The Scenario {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="scenario" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px;"}
It's **10:00 AM**. Your Department Head sends a **40-page PDF** — *"Global Trends in Green Hydrogen 2025"*.

Board meeting at **11:00 AM**. They need a **1-page Executive Summary**.
:::

. . .

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="text-align: center; color: #FF7A5C; font-weight: bold;"}
Old way: 2+ hours

Read → Highlight → Panic-type
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="text-align: center; color: #00C9A7; font-weight: bold;"}
Your way: 10 minutes

Upload → Instruct → Verify
:::
:::
::::

## Step 1: Upload {auto-animate=true}

Open **Hermes** (or NotebookLM / Claude / ChatGPT with file upload) and drag in the PDF.

::: {.callout-note}
## Use the [IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2024](https://www.iea.org/reports/global-hydrogen-review-2024)
100+ pages — perfect for demonstrating the power of grounded research.
:::

## Step 2: Interrogate {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7; font-size: 0.82em;"}
"Act as a Strategy Consultant for a Saudi energy company.

Based *strictly* on this report, outline the 3 biggest opportunities and 3 biggest risks for our market.

If the information is not in the report, state 'Not found in source.' Do not hallucinate.

Include page references for every point. Conclude with a 'Recommended Stance' for the board."
:::

## Step 3: Verify & Deliver {auto-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Verify citations** — click the page references, check the source text
2. **Edit for tone** — match your company's board style
3. **Optional flex** — generate an Audio Overview and send the link
:::

## Step 4: Close the Loop {auto-animate=true}

Now that you have the facts, **delegation** kicks in:

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.85em;"}
"Based on this summary, draft a high-priority email to my Director.

- **Context:** he's heading into a ministry meeting
- **Task:** warn him about the 'Euro-Deal' risks we found
- **Constraint:** 'Saudi Executive' tone, bullet points only."
:::

## Now: Your Backlog

::: {.callout-tip}
## Apply it to real work
Got a "read a long document and summarize it" task on your Automation Backlog? Run this
research workflow on a real (safe) document and log the time: **10 minutes vs. the hours
it used to take.**
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {.callout-tip}
## Deep Research (Perplexity / Gemini)
Live web access. NotebookLM can't do this — it only reads your docs.
:::
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Context before content** — never start with a blank prompt
2. **Build a Trust Layer** — upload your sources, constrain the AI
3. **No citation = didn't happen** — demand page references
4. **Right tool, right job** — Hermes first; NotebookLM / Deep Research as alternatives
5. **10 minutes, not 10 hours** — upload, interrogate, verify
:::
